text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've got some free time, so I decide to
try out the
new battle royale game
people are raving about.
It's especially
popular for its crafting elements
and
traps.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The game is also playable on the VR
Umalator, so
it's no surprise that I spot
some students from
Tracen in the virtual
lobby.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're on the same team as me!
Lucky you,
getting to see the Monarch
in action!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I spot a few familiar faces on the
opposing team,
too.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Whoooa, we're up against Teio! This
battle is
going to be intense for sure!
Time to combine our
powers, Team
BNW!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ugh, give me a break...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I think that sounds good. We
don't always
get the chance for team
battles, so we should
cooperate with
each other.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The game begins with the players
teleported to
various locations across
the map. There appears
to be a team
camera feature that allows you to

observe your teammates, so I decide to
give it a
try.

text_block_list.name: Ordinary Player
text_block_list.text: Argh, I'm done for! She's too good!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh! That makes thirty! All right,
let's check
the battle log!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? This says my team is losing
overall.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Well, it doesn't really matter! If I take
out all of
our opponents, then we'll still
win.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, and I've just found my thirty-first
victim!
Now be a good little target and
don't resist!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Tch, I've been spotted. Sorry, but I don't
plan on
sticking around!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hm, looks like you won't let me get
away easily!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Stop right there! I won't give up my
pursuit!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Or maybe I will. There's something's
fishy going
on—she keeps fleeing with
no intention of
fighting back.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
The terrain here obstructs one's visual
field.
Exactly the kind of place I'd want
to set a trap!
And no doubt Tickezo and
Taishin are in on this.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hee hee... But now that I'm privy to your
plan, it's
time for me to set an ambush of
my own!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I don't see any sign of her. Did she see
through
the ruse?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hm, this is unexpected. I assumed that
after
sniffing out our trap, "Teio the
Genius" would
burst right in here
regardless.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I bet if Rudolf, the Emperor, were in this
position,
she'd ignore any traps and
valiantly charge in
before making her
opponents yield.

text_block_list.name: Impressed Viewer
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! No strategy works against
her! The
Monarch really is a step above
the Emperor!

text_block_list.name: Stunned Viewer
text_block_list.text:
Racing, video games... The Monarch
rules over
every domain! Haha!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Exactly. I know this is a trap... but what
difference
does that make to me! I'm the
invincible Monarch!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...I'll show you what a true monarch looks
like in
action! Bring it on!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Heh... I knew she'd take the bait.
Taishin, Ticket,
let's go!

text_block_list.name: Taishin and Ticket
text_block_list.text: Roger!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio gracefully dodges the
numerous traps
lying in wait for her, until
eventually, she has the
BNW crew
cornered. However...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Argh, I nearly did it! If I only had a little
more HP
left, then Taishin would've
been a goner!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
That was so close! You stuck it out alone
despite
being outnumbered, and you
even took down me
and Hayahide!
Uwaaagh, you were so braaave!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Well, Teio has the highest individual
score by a
long shot.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
But... I did mess up by falling for your
bluff.
Seems I underestimated your level
of teamwork.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, this is so frustrating! I'll definitely
win next
time though!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, this is so frustrating! I'll definitely
win next
time though!
choice_data_list: 次こそ帝王の強さを見せつけよう！
やっぱり連携すると強いな……
やっぱり連携すると強いね……

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...I just thought of something good! The
next
match should be me against
everyone else!
choice_data_list: 次こそ帝王の強さを見せつけよう！
やっぱり連携すると強いな……
やっぱり連携すると強いね……

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
And I won't be making any more
mistakes! I'll
show you just how powerful
this Monarch is!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Team BNW is left dumbfounded by
Tokai Teio's
foolhardy proposal, but I
get the sense that she
could actually
pull it off.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Still, individual skills are indeed vital.
How about
you join our team and fight
alongside us for one
match? We could
learn from each other.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You serious? Then count me in! I'll
master the
secret behind your strength
in no time!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio and BNW make quite the
formidable
combo. The four of them go
on to dominate the
competition in
subsequent matches.
